en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm river with small rapids in the foreground, rocky banks and leafless trees on the right, and buildings visible along the shoreline. A bridge can be seen farther up the river. Printed Swedish text under the image identifies the scene as a part of the Bäfveån in Uddevalla. On the right side of the card there is a large stamp or overprint indicating that it belongs to Uddevalla Museum.
